title: Overlay axis and slider ticks restate the cap and ranges as literals
body:
## Summary
The overlay divides by a literal 50 and labels 'Lv 50' while MAX_LEVEL and the range constants exist.

## Description
MultiCurveOverlay plots x as p.x / 50 and labels Lv 0 / 25 / 50; CurveParametersPanel ticks restate 50, 500, 1.1 and 2.5. Changing MAX_LEVEL or a range leaves these behind.

## Flow
- Change MAX_LEVEL to 60
- Overlay x reaches 120% and the axis still says Lv 50

## Expected impact
Cap and range edits reach every axis.

## Evaluation
Claim: Axis scale and ticks derive from the shared constants.
Before: 5 literal sites restate MAX_LEVEL or a range.
After: 0 literal sites.
Method: unmeasurable
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: Render MultiCurveOverlay with MAX_LEVEL mocked to 60 and assert the last point x <= 100 and the last label reads Lv 60.

title: generateChartData still emits a totalParams field nothing reads
body:
## Summary
totalParams has no reader outside its producer and a test that pins the object shape.

## Description
generateChartData computes totalParams per sample. Repo-wide grep finds the producer, a legacy copy in _internals/progression-data.ts, and rewardPacing.test.ts toEqual assertions.

## Flow
- Chart data is built
- totalParams is computed and never read

## Expected impact
One less field with no meaning.

## Evaluation
Claim: The field can be removed with its test pin.
Before: 1 producer, 0 production readers (grep totalParams over src and e2e).
After: 0 hits outside tests.
Method: unmeasurable
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: Repo-wide grep plus typecheck after removal; rewardPacing.test.ts (rewards-sibling file this wave) must drop the pin.

title: paddedDomain inverts when a value is above the ceiling
body:
## Summary
A value above ceil yields min greater than max, so the sparkline's y scale flips.

## Description
paddedDomain clamps min and max independently. paddedDomain([120], 0.5, 0, 100) returns min 119.5, max 100, giving a negative range in sparklinePoints. The consumer is the evaluator Sparkline, outside this context, so reachability depends on its domainCeil.

## Flow
- A score exceeds domainCeil
- min > max
- The line is drawn inverted

## Expected impact
A sparkline cannot flip on out-of-range data.

## Evaluation
Claim: min is never greater than max.
Before: paddedDomain([120],0.5,0,100) = {min:119.5,max:100} by the formula.
After: min <= max for any input.
Method: simulation
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: chartMath test with a value above ceil asserting min <= max, plus a check of what domainCeil the evaluator passes.

title: The XP curve chart has no accessible name or summary
body:
## Summary
The main chart svg exposes only per-dot titles, with no name for the graphic.

## Description
XpCurveChart's outer svg has no role or aria-label, while the Build comparison and the pickers now carry state. A screen-reader user gets a sequence of dots with no statement of what the chart is.

## Flow
- Reach the Curves tab with a screen reader
- The chart is announced as unnamed graphics

## Expected impact
The chart is identified and summarised.

## Evaluation
Claim: svg has role=img and a label naming the level range and cap cost.
Before: 0 of 1 chart svgs named.
After: 1 of 1 named.
Method: unmeasurable
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: Component test asserting role=img and an aria-label with the cap XP; decide whether the dots' titles stay exposed.

title: Time to max counts clearing the cap level, which a player never does
body:
## Summary
Cumulative XP and hours to L50 include the 50th level's cost, though reaching L50 needs clearing only 49 levels.

## Description
curveTotals and cumulativeMinutes define cum[L] as clearing levels 1..L, and the same convention feeds milestone hours and the exported XPTotal. At base 100, exp 1.5 level 50's own cost is 35,355 of 724,849 total, 4.9%. The convention is pinned by tests and shared with the XP table export, so which reading is right is a design and data-contract call.

## Flow
- Designer reads Hours to L50
- The figure includes a level the player does not clear on the way to the cap

## Expected impact
Pace targets mean what a designer assumes.

## Evaluation
Claim: XP and hours to reach a level exclude that level's own cost, or the UI says clear.
Before: Hours to L50 includes 4.9% of XP past the point of reaching L50 at 100/1.5.
After: Figure and export agree on one stated definition.
Method: simulation
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction

title: Danger Zones and XP sources could be derived from the live curve
body:
## Summary
The panels are captioned as sample figures now; making them live needs a power and source model that does not exist.

## Description
PowerCurveDangerZones has no caller passing series, and XpSourceBreakdown is a fixed list. Deriving them needs a decided model for player power, enemy difficulty and XP sources, likely fed by combat or economy data.

## Flow
- Designer moves a slider
- Danger Zones does not respond

## Expected impact
Danger Zones answers the question its name asks.

## Evaluation
Claim: Series derive from project data.
Before: 0 of 2 panels respond to any project input.
After: 2 of 2 do.
Method: unmeasurable
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
